		Overview
	

INDUS-AD Monocam contains 96 driving recordings, one camera per recording, with 105,692 decoded frames. The 36.02 GB release includes 22.85 GB of video with face and plate blur, plus timing, calibration, GNSS, and sampled semantic and depth annotations.
The source recordings contain 2 h 56 min of indexed camera time, measured from the first to last camera message in each… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/gagandeepreehal/indus-ad-monocam.
